DBLP.question: Who are the authors of "Attention Is All You Need"?
Did Semih Cayci write Finite-Time Analysis of Gradient Descent for Shallow Transformers?
Return all venues in which Nicholas Carlini published.
DBLP.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?venueAsIRI
WHERE {
  BIND (<https://dblp.org/pid/145/1806> AS ?creator)
  ?paper a dblp:Publication .
  ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?creator .
 ?paper dblp:publishedInStream ?venueAsIRI .
}
